Obviously, the game is not optimized at all and still runs like garbage, despite the game not even being all that pretty and the overall artstyle is kinda bland since they went with a ""realistic"" approach.
2nd flaw, that I think is way bigger and can't even really be fixed with ascendance, is that the areas just aren't really all that readable or fun to traverse in any way. I guess the first area is ok since it's just a giant open desert and field with some caves, but everything after that is just so labyrinthine and hard to explore. You start to understand why they added auto movement with the Seikret, and it's because all the areas are just huge pains in the butt to explore and a lot of areas just have very few landmarks to help memorize the maps. I never had this issue with World, Rise, GU, 4U or 3U. 
Wound system is kinda interesting, but I feel the execution is kinda poor since it just pauses all action to do some attack for some free damage and most weaker monster just get juggled by this mechanic, meaning the only real threats are the larger monsters. I get that you feel strong and badass when doing it, but it seems like a waste to just fully trivialize half the roster. Otherwise, the fights against the later game monsters are genuinely pretty fun, particularly like mizu, but I hope to god G-rank Lagia removes that dumbass minigame that happens at the end of the fight(temu a*s swimming combat).
I dunno, this game just feels kinda weak overall. wait for when ascendance comes out and see if it actually makes any big fixes.

I love Monster Hunter. I have over 200 hours each in Rise and Generations Ultimate and a more modest amount in World, which makes it hurt to not recommend this game. But even after the supposed performance improvements, it runs badly, and the worst part is that the frame timings basically oscillate, which makes me nauseous. I used to play on a ♥♥♥♥♥♥ gaming laptop, so I can tolerate low frame rates, but the stuttering and erratic frame times make me straight up nauseous.

The core combat is as fun as ever, and I think this is one of the best iterations of the Dual Blades. Everything around it is what sucks.

The story sucks ass (okay, all Monster Hunter stories suck), but this is by far the worst one, and it's the one that puts the story most front and center. There are a bunch of 10+ minute slow-walking sequences. The awful cutscenes are at least skippable, but the walking sequences are not. The characters go "wow, look how beautiful these butterflies are" and the camera does a 15-second zoom on them. This happens dozens of times. It feels like the developers didn't trust me to experience this world and find it beautiful on my own. It's patronizing, and ironically it hurts the enjoyment of the game a lot.

And while the game runs like ♥♥♥♥, it also looks flat and just not that good. The animations are top notch like in every Monster Hunter game, and Arkveld's chains probably have more polygons than all of GenU. But the color grading looks awful, random textures look completely flat and are much lower resolution than the rest of the game, and the art style just doesn't do it for me. It might be far more technically impressive than Rise, but Rise looks better to me, and it runs at playable frame rates.

They spent a huge amount of time and effort building a massive world that the Seikret's auto-run makes completely irrelevant. I have no incentive to explore it, which isn't helped by the performance.

The QoL from Rise is basically gone. Things that took 2 button presses now take 5 to 10 for no reason.

The combat is still fun, but literally everything else is some of the worst in any Monster Hunter game I've played. If you think you can tolerate the performance and everything around the combat, which the game for some reason keeps you away from as much as it can, go ahead. Everyone else, stay away.

For a player who have just start the series in World, I personally think that this is a great improvement from World. 

I have played World for roughly 370 hours, i don't considered myself veteran to the game but there's a lot of thing i really like about Wilds, I like how the slinger aiming is improve by a lot, its just auto lock if you did click the thing you want to collect, there's mount that you could use in many ways and it is great live saver in a lot of time, and it make you able to whetstone your weapon while mounting.

Focus mode is a REALLY REALLY GREAT addition, its a new mechanic into the game and it really help a lot, you will actually face the monster the way your cam face toward and its allow you to see wounded part, shoot slinger and is a lot better than monster locking system.

Ofc there's also things that I think still need to change like how bad the difficulties change around late game, and how short the main story line ends in base game, in World it will take you around 20 hrs to complete the story first time or less than that but it still be at least 10 hrs for first time, In Wilds that took like 8 to 12 hrs to complete the whole story line and there's no master rank yet which also shorten the content for me at least.

Lastly although the game didn't turn out perfect, the performance issues for older gens pc (which make me un-able to play with my friends) if they gonna choose to optimize the performance seriously it could have been better, yes i know its a lot better now bc i was there too when the Beta Test came out but theres still room for improvement, and i think better to just wait for DLC to came out before buying this.

Such a wonderful version, with many improvements over previous ones. This Wilds version provides "mantles" (additional equipment that supports players by allowing them to evade or become immune to certain monster effects) for new players, instead of requiring them to complete numerous annoying side quests as before. On the other hand, when players have filled all the slots in their pouches, this version allows them to collect additional items and store them in their inventory instead. The Focus Mode (better switched from Hold to Toggle) allows us to target vulnerable parts to weaken monsters, which is another wonderful improvement in this version.

Besides, recent updates have already fixed the annoying performance issues. The Medium/Low graphics settings combined with Balanced/Performance mode work best for me, with no issues at all.

The game is fun. 

Performance could be better (I average around 80 fps on mostly medium settings). It is believed it will be improved with the release of the Ascendance expansion.

In my ~50 hours of playing the game has crashed twice, neither of which happened at critical moments during hunts or cutscenes so I'm not too beat up about it. 

I got the base game for like $24 USD, definitely worth the price for me. As someone who is relatively new to the series (having played Rise and World), this feels like a good evolution for the series gameplay wise. You could argue focus mode is maybe a little too forgiving with positioning, but honestly, I think its just a fun mechanic that allows you to hit the monster more consistently. If you're a purist about it you can just not use it.

Endgame isn't interesting or fair at all. Every fight after the base game final boss is a higher damage, more spammy version of something you already fought. The support hunters that are supposed to ,you Know, SUPPORT you don't take agro hardly at all and do poor damage. forget calling for aid because randoms are just as bad if not worse than the AI hunters. Save yourself the money and headache do not purchase this garbage.

缺点：离谱剧情，熬夜推主线香翅大芬。一，男主刻画基本=0，对隔壁村小女孩有明显的特殊感情，后面却为何不了了之；前期对锁刃龙抱有明显敌意，甚至想徒手冲上去干架。但是却因为同情它的遭遇而选择原谅，非常的莫名其妙。二，玩家剧情数值膨胀，千年前的灭世灾厄被玩家强行讨伐，没有一点史诗感。相比之下崛起就合理的多，玩家利用弩炮，龙击炮，以及全村动员的力量才完成对风雷神龙的狩猎。还有就是dlc，卡普空万年不变的套路，什么叫扩展内容比游戏本体贵？更气人的是我离线游戏30小时的存档愣是没加到我的游玩时间 >_<

不过这一切都无所谓了喵，艾露猫太可爱了喵，一定要买营地扩充包喵，咪咪小床床可爱捏，很值捏~

This game was my first introduction to the Monster Hunter series-Well actually, I had played World for a tiny bit and didn't find it quite fun, too overwhelming and complicated. But now, I bought this game to play with my friend and he's a huge monster hunter fan. And he showed me how to play, and one I learned, it's goated. So many monsters, so many weapons, so many armor pieces, so many quests, so many things to do in this GOATED game. Genuinely try this game out, because I swear you'll like it. This game is also really fun with friends.

Only real complaints is the FPS and textures, but it's mostly fine if you use A.I upscaling.
